_what: THE REPOSITORY'S REGISTER OF GENERATED PLACEHOLDERS. Every id listed here names a file under assets/final/ whose bytes are exactly what tools/postprocess/placeholder.ts's `makePlaceholder(placeholderLabel(path), width, height, {palette})` produces today — a flat block, a border, the asset id in a 3x5 font, and at map-native size a strip of the whole frozen palette. NONE of them is art.
_whyItLivesHere: It used to live at assets/final/dex-painted/stand-ins.json, beside the 35 placeholders it listed, and that coupling was a defect: a register of WHICH SHIPPED FILES ARE PLACEHOLDERS has repository scope, so parking it inside one asset class made an unrelated ruling — cut line C-4, which deleted that class — capable of destroying the whole corpus, the positive control tests/gates/stand-in-declaration.test.ts validates its detector against, and the non-vacuity instrument behind tests/gates/dex-path-contract.test.ts. It now sits at the root of the shipping tree, where deleting any single class cannot take it. Per-directory declarations still work — game/placeholder.ts globs assets/final/**/stand-ins.json and this gate walks the same tree — but this file is the home.
_writtenBy: tools/postprocess/run.ts `placeholders` (writePlaceholders), which now emits this file in the same act that writes the PNGs, derived by measuring every PNG under assets/final/ with `isStandInRaster`. It was hand-authored before, which is why a register that must be exactly right was maintained by whoever remembered to. Re-run `npx tsx tools/postprocess/run.ts placeholders` to regenerate it.
_verifiedBy: tests/gates/stand-in-declaration.test.ts re-derives the true set FROM THE PIXELS and asserts this list is that set exactly, in both directions — landing real art at a listed path reddens the suite until the id is removed, and writing a placeholder without listing it reddens it too. Do not hand-edit this list to make something look built.
_consumedBy: game/placeholder.ts globs assets/final/**/stand-ins.json at BUILD time (the game cannot read pixels to decide) and refuses to register anything listed here as real art: hasRealAsset() answers false, BootScene's queueRealAssets never queues it, and the game goes on drawing its own slot-sized labelled stand-in — which stays legible where an offline placeholder generated at the class's own target size does not.
_emptyMeans: EMPTY IS A MEASURED STATEMENT, NOT AN UNFILLED FIELD: nothing currently under assets/final/ is a generated placeholder. The 35 entries this file used to carry were all dex-painted plates, and cut line C-4 deleted that class — a register of ids that name no file is a fossil, not a control, so they went with it rather than being kept for the tests that leaned on them. Those tests now construct their own placeholder through the real writer instead of borrowing a committed one.
